item.title: Harness Engineering Principles - Architecture Wisdom from Claude Code
item.description: Distilling Claude Code's six core Harness Engineering principles: prompts as control plane, cache-aware design, fail-closed, A/B testing everything, observe before fixing, and latching for stability - plus how to apply them to AI Agent system construction.
